notes.title: Steam Tower Defense Fest
notes.content:
Name your company, build an office, hire staff and defend the Moon! Kite Shield is releasing a new ‘Moon Corp. TD’ demo for Steam Tower Defense Fest to share new office building possibilities and challenging tower defense maps.

New features:

 Office pod building
 Controller support
 More TD maps
 UX refined and UI improved

notes.title: New Demo! - Steam Base Builder Fest
notes.content:
Hello Moon Corp CEOs,
Our team has been preparing a demo for Steam Base Builder Fest and, while we are a bit late, it is now live for download! We are continuing to work on game systems so please let us know if you find bugs, have feedback or suggestions. Let us know what you would like to see!

New features:

Multiple office levels and elevator.
Customization of office pods. Place desks, whiteboards and all sorts of goodies.
Hire employees to research upgrades faster.
Research tree progress based on number of employees, their skill and your office equipment.
Sewer mission, fight Zelpha over the fat-burgs!
Tower defense drone camera now rotates.
Turret UI and placement feedback.
Turret and mech override combat improvements.
And more!


We have also started a Moon Corp. TD Discord server if you would like to see some extra development news and community challenges in future. 
https://discord.gg/eGZhh9UrGq

Have fun during Steam Base Builder Fest and enjoy the new demo!

Best Regards,
Kite Shield Interactive Team



P.S.
A few known issues with the demo, a later update will aim to fix these and any other bugs you find.

Known issues:
-	Interacting with office employees while talking reopens dialogue when rather than closing it.
-	Turrets don’t show “not enough funds” error when selecting a weapon that is too expensive.
-	Various infinite money loops… (see if you can find them)
-	News intro dialogue delays are too slow.
-	Research tree is not clearly showing what upgrades are unlocked, available and active.
-	Office objective markers don’t always show the right way to go.
-	Loading into the office shows popping and steaming of objects.
